newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil drifts lower on quiet Euro veg oil market.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil drifts lower on quiet Euro veg oil market.

text.p: Palm oil prices drifted lower in Europe during Friday morning on a quiet market.

Traders said there was the usual Friday lack of interest among buyers coupled with the feeling that the market had been over-done in recent days and talk in Malaysia of lower than expected local exports between January 1 and 25.
"I get the feeling it's going to be a very quiet day," said one trader.
Crude palm oil cif Europe was unchanged to $2.50 down at midday with no business reported.
Among products RBD oil was $2.50 lower after March traded at $548.50 and April at $541 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Olein sellers were $5 down after February traded at $585 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
In soft oils soy oil was 0.25 guilders up while rape oil was 0.50 to one guilder higher, but buyers were not following.
Rape oil is no longer offered at a premium over soy oil and at midday offers were at even money.
Lauric oils were quiet with coconut oil unchanged to $5 up and palmkernel oil $5 higher. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
